basic_details.job_title: IGNOU Senior Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Senior Consultant (Administration) on a contract basis. Candidates can apply offline by downloading the application format, attaching self-attested copies of testimonials and documents, and sending the complete application by post to the Deputy Registrar, Recruitment Cell, Administration Division, Block-7, Room No.13, IGNOU, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi on or before 3 November 2026. content_sections.heading: IGNOU Senior Consultant (Administration) at a Glance

rows.details: Rs. 50,000-70,000/- to be decided by the Selection committee
Bachelors’ Degree with 5-7 years of administrative and legal/disciplinary experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Complete applications along with testimonials duly self-attested must be sent to the following postal address: Deputy Registrar, Recruitment Cell, Administration Division, Block-7, Room No.13, IGNOU, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068 Candidates must write “Application for the engagement of Administrative Associate Administration Division, IGNOU” in capital letters on the top of the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree with 5-7 years of experience in all administrative matters and handling of legal/disciplinary matters in a Central Government or Central University. Preference is given to retired personnel at the level of Under Secretary, Assistant Registrar, or Administrative Officer. Up to attaining the age of 70 years. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting by the University followed by an interview before a Selection Committee. Merely fulfilling educational qualifications and experience does not entitle any person to be called for the interview. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Senior Consultant (Administration) position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 03.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s Degree along with 5-7 years of experience in administrative matters and handling legal or disciplinary matters in a Central Government or Central University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to attaining the age of 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration offered?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000/-, to be decided by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application format from the IGNOU website, attach self-attested testimonials, and send the complete application by post to the Deputy Registrar, Recruitment Cell.

faq.question: Q7. What is the initial duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of six months and is further extendable on a performance basis up to a maximum period of two years or until attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What selection stages are involved?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates by the University followed by an interview.
